import ast
import base64
import copy
from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta
import io
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import uuid
import zipfile
sys.path.insert(0, '/home/r/dev/minor/stackd/scripts/aws')
from aws_cli import run, result

OUT = Path('/home/r/dev/minor/stackd/testdata/aws/cloudwatch/metric_insights_contributor_actions.json')
PREFIX = 'sd-mi-actions-' + uuid.uuid4().hex[:12]
ACCOUNT = '000000000000'
REGION = 'us-west-2'
ALARMS = [PREFIX + '-grouped', PREFIX + '-single']
FUNCTION = PREFIX
ROLE = PREFIX
LOG = '/aws/lambda/' + FUNCTION
NS = 'Stackd/InsightsActions/' + PREFIX
FARN = f'arn:aws:lambda:{REGION}:{ACCOUNT}:function:{FUNCTION}'
AARN = f'arn:aws:cloudwatch:{REGION}:{ACCOUNT}:alarm:{ALARMS[0]}'
ASARN = f'arn:aws:autoscaling:{REGION}:{ACCOUNT}:scalingPolicy:{uuid.uuid4()}:autoScalingGroupName/{PREFIX}:policyName/{PREFIX}'
ENV = dict(os.environ, AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=REGION, AWS_REGION=REGION, AWS_MAX_ATTEMPTS='1', AWS_PAGER='', AWS_IGNORE_CONFIGURED_ENDPOINT_URLS='true')
for k in list(ENV):
    if k.startswith('AWS_ENDPOINT_URL'):
        del ENV[k]
URLS = ['https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/alarm-actions.html', 'https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/alarms-and-actions-Lambda.html', 'https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/monitoring/multi-time-series-alarm.html', 'https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonCloudWatch/latest/APIReference/API_PutMetricAlarm.html']
CAP = {'caller_account': ACCOUNT, 'actor_arn': f'arn:aws:iam::{ACCOUNT}:user/Delegated', 'region': REGION, 'started_at': datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(), 'cli_version': subprocess.run(['aws','--version'], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip(), 'sources': [{'url': u} for u in URLS] + [{'path': __file__, 'content': Path(__file__).read_text()}], 'owned_resources': {'alarms': ALARMS, 'lambda_function': FUNCTION, 'execution_role': ROLE, 'inline_role_policy': 'OwnedLogs', 'function_permission': 'OwnedAlarm', 'log_group': LOG, 'namespace': NS, 'metric_name': 'Load', 'metric_identities': ['a','b'], 'autoscaling_resources_created': False}, 'protocol': {'phase_deadline_seconds': 300, 'poll_interval_seconds': 20, 'metric_period_seconds': 60, 'evaluation_periods': 1, 'threshold': 10, 'account_telemetry_settings_modified': False, 'auto_scaling_action_execution': 'Not attempted; nonexistent uniquely owned policy ARN used only with disabled actions.', 'maximum_metric_samples': 40}, 'observations': [], 'admission': [], 'phases': [], 'lambda_events': [], 'cleanup': [], 'metric_samples': 0}
created = set()
last_minute = None

def save():
    OUT.write_text(json.dumps(CAP, indent=2) + '\n')

def call(label, service, op, params, cleanup=False):
    params = copy.deepcopy(params)
    started = time.time()
    p = run(service, op, params, ENV, options=('--debug','--no-paginate','--cli-connect-timeout','10','--cli-read-timeout','25'), timeout=40)
    r = result(p, debug=True, cli_message=None)
    for line in reversed(p.stderr.splitlines()):
        if 'Response headers:' in line:
            try:
                headers = ast.literal_eval(line.split('Response headers:',1)[1].strip())
                for k,v in headers.items():
                    if k.lower() in ('x-amzn-requestid','x-amzn-request-id','x-amz-request-id'):
                        r['request_id'] = v
            except (ValueError,SyntaxError):
                pass
            break
    if service == 'sts' and r['code'] == 'Success':
        r['output'].pop('UserId',None)
    CAP['cleanup' if cleanup else 'observations'].append({'label': label, 'service': service, 'operation': op, 'input': params, 'request_started_ms': round(started*1000), 'request_finished_ms': round(time.time()*1000), 'result': r})
    save()
    return r

def require(r):
    if r['code'] != 'Success':
        raise RuntimeError(json.dumps(r))
    return r['output']

def alarm(grouped=True):
    return {'AlarmName': ALARMS[0 if grouped else 1], 'ComparisonOperator':'GreaterThanThreshold','EvaluationPeriods':1,'DatapointsToAlarm':1,'Threshold':10,'ActionsEnabled':False,'OKActions':[],'AlarmActions':[],'InsufficientDataActions':[],'TreatMissingData':'notBreaching','Metrics':[{'Id':'q','Expression': 'SELECT MAX(Load) FROM "'+NS+'"'+(' GROUP BY Team ORDER BY MAX() DESC' if grouped else ''), 'Period':60,'ReturnData':True}]}

def publish(label, values):
    global last_minute
    minute = int(time.time()//60)
    if minute == last_minute:
        return
    if CAP['metric_samples']+len(values)>40:
        raise RuntimeError('metric publication cap')
    require(call(label+'-publish','cloudwatch','put-metric-data',{'Namespace':NS,'MetricData':[{'MetricName':'Load','Dimensions':[{'Name':'Team','Value':g}],'Timestamp':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'Value':v,'Unit':'Count'} for g,v in values.items()]}))
    last_minute = minute
    CAP['metric_samples'] += len(values)
    save()

def leaves(value):
    if isinstance(value,dict):
        return [x for v in value.values() for x in leaves(v)]
    if isinstance(value,list):
        return [x for v in value for x in leaves(v)]
    return [value]

def logs(label):
    r = call(label+'-logs','logs','filter-log-events',{'logGroupName':LOG,'filterPattern':'"OWNED_PAYLOAD"','limit':100})
    if r['code']=='Success':
        ids = {e['event_id'] for e in CAP['lambda_events']}
        for e in r['output'].get('events',[]):
            if e['eventId'] in ids:
                continue
            text = e['message'].split('OWNED_PAYLOAD ',1)[-1].strip()
            try:
                payload = json.loads(text)
            except json.JSONDecodeError:
                continue
            CAP['lambda_events'].append({'event_id':e['eventId'],'timestamp':e['timestamp'],'log_stream':e['logStreamName'],'payload':payload})
    save()

def phase(name, values, active, deliveries):
    ph = {'name':name,'started_at':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'values':copy.deepcopy(values),'expected_active_contributors':sorted(active),'expected_deliveries':deliveries,'outcome':'inconclusive'}
    CAP['phases'].append(ph)
    initial_ids = {e['event_id'] for e in CAP['lambda_events']}
    deadline = time.monotonic()+300
    while time.monotonic()<deadline:
        publish(name, values)
        now = datetime.now(timezone.utc)
        q = call(name+'-query','cloudwatch','get-metric-data',{'StartTime':(now-timedelta(minutes=3)).isoformat(),'EndTime':now.isoformat(),'MetricDataQueries':copy.deepcopy(alarm()['Metrics'])})
        a = call(name+'-parent','cloudwatch','describe-alarms',{'AlarmNames':[ALARMS[0]]})
        c = call(name+'-contributors','cloudwatch','describe-alarm-contributors',{'AlarmName':ALARMS[0]})
        logs(name)
        new = [e for e in CAP['lambda_events'] if e['event_id'] not in initial_ids]
        contributors = c.get('output',{}).get('AlarmContributors',[])
        groups = {x.get('ContributorAttributes',{}).get('Team') for x in contributors if x.get('StateValue')=='ALARM'}
        parents = a.get('output',{}).get('MetricAlarms',[])
        parent_ok = parents and parents[0]['StateValue']==('ALARM' if active else 'OK')
        delivery_ok = all(any(g in leaves(e['payload']) and state in leaves(e['payload']) for e in new) for g,state in deliveries)
        query_ok = any(x.get('Values') for x in q.get('output',{}).get('MetricDataResults',[]))
        if groups==active and parent_ok and delivery_ok and query_ok:
            ph['outcome']='observed'
            break
        time.sleep(min(20,max(0,deadline-time.monotonic())))
    ph['finished_at']=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    ph['new_lambda_event_ids']=[e['event_id'] for e in CAP['lambda_events'] if e['event_id'] not in initial_ids]
    save()
    return ph['outcome']=='observed'

try:
    ident = require(call('identity','sts','get-caller-identity',{}))
    if ident['Account']!=ACCOUNT or ident['Arn']!=CAP['actor_arn']:
        raise RuntimeError('unexpected AWS identity')
    for grouped in (True,False):
        for category,arn in [('lambda',FARN),('autoscaling',ASARN)]:
            for field in ('AlarmActions','OKActions','InsufficientDataActions'):
                req = alarm(grouped)
                req[field]=[arn]
                r = call(('grouped' if grouped else 'single')+'-'+category+'-'+field,'cloudwatch','put-metric-alarm',req)
                if r['code']=='Success':
                    created.add('alarms')
                CAP['admission'].append({'grouped':grouped,'category':category,'field':field,'code':r['code'],'message':r.get('message')})
                save()
    accepted = all(any(x['grouped'] and x['category']=='lambda' and x['field']==f and x['code']=='Success' for x in CAP['admission']) for f in ('AlarmActions','OKActions'))
    CAP['lambda_runtime_supported_by_admission']=accepted
    if accepted:
        require(call('create-owned-logs','logs','create-log-group',{'logGroupName':LOG}))
        created.add('logs')
        require(call('logs-retention','logs','put-retention-policy',{'logGroupName':LOG,'retentionInDays':1}))
        trust = {'Version':'2012-10-17','Statement':[{'Effect':'Allow','Principal':{'Service':'lambda.amazonaws.com'},'Action':'sts:AssumeRole'}]}
        role = require(call('create-execution-role','iam','create-role',{'RoleName':ROLE,'AssumeRolePolicyDocument':json.dumps(trust)}))
        created.add('role')
        policy = {'Version':'2012-10-17','Statement':[{'Effect':'Allow','Action':['logs:CreateLogStream','logs:PutLogEvents'],'Resource':f'arn:aws:logs:{REGION}:{ACCOUNT}:log-group:{LOG}:*'}]}
        require(call('least-privilege-logs','iam','put-role-policy',{'RoleName':ROLE,'PolicyName':'OwnedLogs','PolicyDocument':json.dumps(policy)}))
        created.add('policy')
        source = 'import json\ndef handler(event, context):\n    print("OWNED_PAYLOAD " + json.dumps(event, sort_keys=True))\n    return {"captured": True}\n'
        CAP['lambda_source']=source
        archive = io.BytesIO()
        with zipfile.ZipFile(archive,'w',zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
            z.writestr('index.py',source)
        req = {'FunctionName':FUNCTION,'Runtime':'python3.12','Role':role['Role']['Arn'],'Handler':'index.handler','Code':{'ZipFile':base64.b64encode(archive.getvalue()).decode()},'Timeout':5,'MemorySize':128}
        deadline = time.monotonic()+100
        while True:
            r=call('create-lambda','lambda','create-function',req)
            if r['code']=='Success':
                created.add('function')
                break
            if time.monotonic()>=deadline or 'cannot be assumed' not in r.get('message',''):
                require(r)
            time.sleep(10)
        require(call('permit-only-owned-alarm','lambda','add-permission',{'FunctionName':FUNCTION,'StatementId':'OwnedAlarm','Action':'lambda:InvokeFunction','Principal':'lambda.alarms.cloudwatch.amazonaws.com','SourceAccount':ACCOUNT,'SourceArn':AARN}))
        created.add('permission')
        require(call('read-invocation-authority','lambda','get-policy',{'FunctionName':FUNCTION}))
        deadline=time.monotonic()+100
        while True:
            cfg=require(call('function-readiness','lambda','get-function-configuration',{'FunctionName':FUNCTION}))
            if cfg['State']=='Active':
                break
            if time.monotonic()>=deadline:
                raise RuntimeError('lambda readiness deadline')
            time.sleep(5)
        live=alarm()
        live.update(ActionsEnabled=True, AlarmActions=[FARN], OKActions=[FARN])
        require(call('enable-real-lambda-action','cloudwatch','put-metric-alarm',live))
        first=phase('a-only-alarm',{'a':20,'b':5},{'a'},[['a','ALARM']])
        second=phase('both-alarm-parent-remains-alarm',{'a':20,'b':30},{'a','b'},[['b','ALARM']])
        third=phase('both-recover',{'a':5,'b':5},set(),[['a','OK'],['b','OK']])
        call('final-history','cloudwatch','describe-alarm-history',{'AlarmName':ALARMS[0],'MaxRecords':100,'ScanBy':'TimestampAscending'})
        logs('final')
    else:
        require(call('positive-grouped-control','cloudwatch','put-metric-alarm',alarm()))
        created.add('alarms')
        phase('positive-evaluation-control',{'a':20,'b':5},{'a'},[])
except BaseException as e:
    CAP['probe_error']={'type':type(e).__name__,'message':str(e)}
finally:
    if 'alarms' in created:
        call('delete-owned-alarms','cloudwatch','delete-alarms',{'AlarmNames':ALARMS},True)
    call('verify-alarms-absent','cloudwatch','describe-alarms',{'AlarmNames':ALARMS},True)
    if 'permission' in created:
        call('remove-function-permission','lambda','remove-permission',{'FunctionName':FUNCTION,'StatementId':'OwnedAlarm'},True)
    if 'function' in created:
        call('delete-function','lambda','delete-function',{'FunctionName':FUNCTION},True)
    call('verify-function-absent','lambda','get-function',{'FunctionName':FUNCTION},True)
    call('verify-function-policy-absent','lambda','get-policy',{'FunctionName':FUNCTION},True)
    if 'policy' in created:
        call('delete-inline-policy','iam','delete-role-policy',{'RoleName':ROLE,'PolicyName':'OwnedLogs'},True)
    call('verify-inline-policy-absent','iam','get-role-policy',{'RoleName':ROLE,'PolicyName':'OwnedLogs'},True)
    if 'role' in created:
        call('delete-role','iam','delete-role',{'RoleName':ROLE},True)
    call('verify-role-absent','iam','get-role',{'RoleName':ROLE},True)
    if 'logs' in created:
        call('delete-owned-log-group','logs','delete-log-group',{'logGroupName':LOG},True)
    call('verify-log-group-absent','logs','describe-log-groups',{'logGroupNamePrefix':LOG},True)
    CAP['remaining_custom_metrics']={'namespace':NS,'metric_name':'Load','identities':['a','b'] if CAP['metric_samples'] else [],'note':'CloudWatch custom metric samples cannot be deleted; they expire under normal retention. No further publication.'}
    CAP['finished_at']=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    save()
    print(json.dumps({'output':str(OUT),'prefix':PREFIX,'admission':CAP['admission'],'phases':CAP['phases'],'events':CAP['lambda_events'],'error':CAP.get('probe_error'),'cleanup':[(x['label'],x['result']['code']) for x in CAP['cleanup']]}))
